hero.title: Three floors, built in order.
hero.sub: One building in Chamba growing floor by floor as each community proves itself. Floor G is open now; upper floors open only when the community is ready.
hero.strip: Behind the Post Office, Chamba, Himachal Pradesh. Mon–Sat, 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM.

switcher.prompt: Select a floor to view or inspect the drawing:

floors.name: Floor G: Learning Commons
floors.summary: Small-group classes, daily practice tests, doubt clinics, and fellowship teaching.
floors.description: The ground floor is Synapse's active classroom in Chamba. Students work in small groups with a guide who knows every learner. Every class concludes with a short practice test on the topic just taught, and doubts are solved in separate dedicated sessions.
items: Small-group classes across four tracks (PCM, PCB, CUET UG)
Daily practice tests at the end of each class
Doubt clinics in separate short sessions
Entrance baseline diagnostic for children (places learners, never excludes)
Teaching fellows: graduates teaching one class a day while preparing
floors.feeNotice: Fees are shared when you enquire.

floors.name: Floor 1: Knowledge Commons
floors.condition: Opening when people will buy the card
floors.summary: A library open to anyone with a card, opening when people will buy the card.
floors.description: We plan a quiet library for study and reading, open to any learner or resident with a reader card. It will house dedicated desks for quiet study and curated reference collections.
items: Library open to anyone with a reader card
Quiet desks for reading and study
Community study space when demand is proven
floors.feeNotice: Fees are shared when you enquire.

floors.name: Floor 2: Venture Hub
floors.condition: Opening only when there are real founders
floors.summary: Desks for a few startups who must teach, opening only when there are real founders.
floors.description: We intend the top floor for local founders and builders who commit to teaching and mentoring children in return for desk space and community. It will open only when real founders are present in the district.
items: Desks and community for local founders and builders
Founders teach and mentor children in return for space
The exact teaching commitment is agreed per founder
Opens only when there are real founders
floors.feeNotice: Fees are shared when you enquire.

growthRule.label: THE GROWTH RULE
growthRule.title: Built only from revenue. No outside money until 5-6 centres.
growthRule.description: Synapse expands strictly in order. Floor G finances its own guide and classroom. Floor 1 opens only when enough readers purchase cards. Floor 2 opens only when genuine founders need desks. We take no outside capital until 5-6 centres are thriving.
